text:
elaine: Quick check — final pass on website pages (hosted / dedicated / private) + launch posts + webinar hooks. Need: 1) hero variants 2) benchmark narrative for blog + social 3) registration funnel + inbound routing. Can we align by EOD?
omar: On it. I updated three hero lines; keeping them short — one-liners with metric-led subtext. Posting variants in figma now. :pushpin:
li: saw them, will paste screenshots in a sec. leaning toward a tighter H1 for Hosted — less jargon, more outcome.
nate: routing question — do we want separate inbound paths for Hosted leads vs Dedicated/Private (sales-assist)? My thought: Hosted -> product trial + self-serve nurture; Dedicated/Private -> SDR + solutions form.
marta: agree. Also benchmark narrative should call out 3 repeatable scenarios: latency-first microservices, high-throughput batch embeddings, and regulated workloads. Each gets a one-line result + metric. Example: "Up to 4x lower token cost with optimized batching" (we'll A/B the copy).
elaine: perfect. Omar/ Li — can we map hero -> one-sentence pitch -> benchmark bullet -> primary CTA for each mode? Keep CTAs consistent but different verbs: Hosted = Try Hosted, Dedicated = Request Capacity, Private = Talk to Sales.
omar: yep — draft payloads below. Feedback welcome.
```
HOSTED
H1: Fast inference, zero infra setup.
H2: Get consistent latency and predictable pricing via our hosted API.
Bullets: Low-latency streaming; Auto batching to reduce costs; Model catalog with vetted profiles.
CTA: Try Hosted (free credits)

DEDICATED
H1: Dedicated GPU pools for sustained throughput.
H2: Predictable capacity and isolation for production-scale workloads.
Bullets: Commit pricing, autoscaling, SLA-backed latency targets.
CTA: Request Capacity

PRIVATE
H1: Inference behind your VPC or on-prem.
H2: Compliance, fine-grained control, and private control plane.
Bullets: KMS/HSM support; Audit logs; Air-gapped options.
CTA: Talk to Sales
```
li: looks good. small wording nits: Hosted H2 swap to "Start in minutes, scale predictably" — feels more onboarding-friendly. Also can we shorten Dedicated H1 to "Dedicated capacity, predictable throughput"?
omar: done. Also adding micro-CTAs for benchmark pages: "See benchmark" under each bullet linking to the blog.
nate: inbound routing detail: use hidden form fields on Hosted trial form: "lead_segment=hosted" and "utm_campaign=launch_june". For Dedicated/Private forms, route to SFDC queues: queue=enterprise_engage. Also add an automation: if predicted ARR > $50k then tag as "high-touch".
marta: for benchmark narrative — I'll draft three 250-300 word case snippets (one per scenario) with data points and a clear method note. Will include a small methodology callout: dataset, seq len, hardware.
elaine: timeline: Marta bench drafts by midday tomorrow, Omar + Li finish page copy + hero assets today EOD, Nate wires routing rules and forms by EOD, I'll assemble launch post drafts and webinar outline.
omar: social schedule queued with deploy-bot, but holding until web copy final.
deploy-bot: social-posts-scheduler: queued 2026-06-10 09:00 UTC for initial threads; holding until manual release.
li: small ask — webinar landing needs a short 1-line benefit for attendees and 3 bullets of takeaways. Also add a checkbox for "I want a capacity consult" that maps to Dedicated/Private route.
nate: noted. Also recommend capturing first-message token sample and a latency sample on the registration confirmation page (we can show a micro-benchmark snippet to build credibility).
marta: I'll include a visual benchmark card that summarizes the 3 scenarios (icon + metric).
elaine: ok team — final checklist: 1) publish page copy to staging + screenshots in figma 2) wire inbound forms + hidden fields 3) benchmark blog ready for linking 4) webinar landing + registration flow 5) draft launch posts and social images. Post updates in thread as done. :rocket:
omar: publishing page copy to staging now. link: https://staging.redwood.ai/pages/launch-copy (mock)
li: uploading hero comps to figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd/launch-hero-variants
nate: SFDC queues created: enterprise_engage, hosted_trial. routing rule snippets: `if form.lead_segment == "hosted" then assign_queue = "hosted_trial" else if form.type in ["dedicated","private"] then assign_queue = "enterprise_engage"`
marta: draft benchmarks uploaded: https://drive.redwood.ai/benchmarks/june-launch-drafts (comments welcome)
elaine: awesome. I'll pull together the webinar outline (30 min + 15 Q&A) and start a short registration email copy. Will ping here when ready.
omar: :thumbsup:
elaine: tagging @nate @marta @li @omar for the EOD check-in. Thanks team.
